messages:
inc-bot: Pager SEV2 -> multiple tenants observing elevated 5xx and tail latency originating from prefix/KV cache READs. Alert: KV read p99 > 500ms; error spike started ~2004009800 UTC. Incident created INC-2026-405. Paging oncall.

mike (oncall): I'm paged, looking now. Which clusters/regions? any customer impact specifics?

devon (runtime): seeing spikes across us-west-2 and eu-central-1. Top impacted tenants: tenant-88 (payments), tenant-210 (search), and some internal test traffic. Error mode is "kv_miss_timeout" then fallback 503. Latency: read path hitting remote storage on misses due to prefetch backlog.

sara (sre): paging in case we need traffic surgery. If we can limit prefix lookups per-tenant that should reduce downstream load. Recommend initial mitigations: 1) tenant-level read ratecap, 2) disable prefetch for high-traffic prefixes, 3) enable temporary pass-through (bypass local cache but with strict throttling) for correctness-sensitive tenants.

mike (oncall): ack. I'll coordinate. First step: apply a conservative per-tenant read cap for tenant-88 and tenant-210. Devon, can you push a runtime policy? I'll also open an outage notice for tenant-88.

devon (runtime): applying policy now. Pushing config to routing layer:

```
# runtime policy snippet
policies:
  - tenant: tenant-88
    prefix_read_rate_limit: 30 # r/s
    prefetch_enabled: false
  - tenant: tenant-210
    prefix_read_rate_limit: 20
    prefetch_enabled: false
global:
  cache_pass_through_mode: selective
```

devon (runtime): pushed to canary pool (coldpool) at 2004009967, rolling to primary in 60s.

ops-bot: Deploy started -> runtime-policy-v2 -> canary: coldpool-7

mike (oncall): flipping prefetch off for those tenants only. Also please add an override to disable aggressive KV-prefetch for all tenants older than 24h traffic window.

sara (sre): adding a temporary traffic-shaper at the edge to smooth spikes while runtime changes roll:

```
# edge rate-shaper (temporary)
edge-shaper:
  match: prefix=/kv/*
  action: token-bucket
  capacity: 200
  refill_rate: 100r/s
  per-tenant-exempt: false
```

alex (prod-eng): FYI I'm preparing a fallback: route read-heavy requests to cold replica (lower perf but more stable) for any tenant exceeding 60r/s sustained.

mike (oncall): executed edge-shaper at 2004010012. Observability: Please monitor p95/p99 and error rate.

devon (runtime): runtime canary finished, config rolled out to primary at 2004010040. Also enabled cache-pass-through for tenant-88 for correctness (we expect more backend reads but avoids stale reads causing 5xx chain).

sara (sre): customer impact update: tenant-88 reported intermittent errors in payments flow; we've notified customer success. For other tenants, error rate down ~65% after edge-shaper and rate caps. Tail latency p99 reduced from ~1.2s to ~380ms for cache layer in us-west-2.

mike (oncall): good. Next action: if error rate remains >10% for tenant-88, disable KV-prefetch globally for 10m and shift traffic to cold replica per alex's plan. Who will own that? devon?

devon (runtime): I'll own the global prefetch toggle. Plan:

1) turn off prefetch globally (10m window)
2) enable cold-replica routing for read-heavy requests
3) monitor for backend saturation

Commands:
```
# toggle prefetch
POST /admin/feature-toggle
payload: {"feature":"kv_prefetch","state":"off","duration":"10m"}
```

devon (runtime): executing step 1 at 2004010105.

inc-bot: config change detected -> kv_prefetch=off (global) by devon at 2004010105

mike (oncall): observing metrics... backend read QPS jumped ~30% as expected but latency stable. Error rate for tenant-88 trending down further to ~4%.

sara (sre): starting handoff notes for next shift: summary -> root cause appears to be prefetch queue/backpressure causing cache lookup timeouts; mitigations so far: tenant-level read caps, edge rate-shaper, selective cache-pass-through for tenant-88, global prefetch off for 10m, cold-replica routing enabled for heavy readers. Early impact: reduced 5xx spike ~80% overall; some increased backend load.

alex (prod-eng): added a temporary quota bump for internal telemetry to avoid noisy alerts during mitigations. Will revert after stabilization.

mike (oncall): leaving the incident to night oncall in 30m. Handoff: monitor backend read latency, p99 for prefix cache, and customer error rate for tenant-88. If error rate >10% or backend saturation >85% for 5m, escalate to SEV1 and consider traffic shed (disable non-critical inference features: prefetching hot-prefixes, speculative KV writes).

devon (runtime): creating an incident runbook entry and linking changes to INC-2026-405. I'll also capture the exact config diffs and upload logs.

inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-405 updated -> mitigations active. Postmortem requested: assign to devon + sara + alex.

sara (sre): final note before handoff: keep customer-comms short and factual. tenant-88 CS notified; ops runbook updated with rollback commands. Leaving the thread to next oncall. :white_check_mark:
